decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system extends the firm's established two-component spraying expertise at low marginal cost, and with only one year of evidence its uncertain prospects in corrosion-protection markets justify keeping the option open.
The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the core offer, has its own web page signalling commitment, and costs little to keep, so there is no case for abandoning it before its value is revealed.
The multi-model transfer pump line builds on existing pump know-how and in-house manufacturing, keeping it is cheap, and its early stage leaves too much uncertainty to justify dropping it.

Fire protection flow monitoring supports the firm's digitalization strategy and has a dedicated page, and its value in a regulated niche is still unresolved, so management keeps this low-cost option alive.
